dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: ¿Mba’éichapa ohecha nde pe mba’épe heta nde kuéra pe karaigua?
dialogue.translation: How did you see in the news that there are many of those men?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Aipo ñeha’e porãicha, icha ma henda upéicha oiporu ha’ekuéra rembiparape.
dialogue.translation: What they say is good, but now they have to use it like that in their jobs.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Upéicha avei ndaha’éi porãnguéra oñemomba’e ha oñemokañy.
dialogue.translation: In that way, those who work poorly or steal aren’t good either.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ha upeichaite avei ohecha hendive kuéra oñeha’arõva’ekue ojejapóva.
dialogue.translation: And in that way, it’s also seen with them that they prepare to do the right thing.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Pe tekotevẽva oñembo’ehára porãite ha oñekotevẽkuaáva ijapýpe.
dialogue.translation: In what’s necessary, they must be very good and need it in their own place.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Upéicha avei ndaha’éi maitei oñeha’arõ.
dialogue.translation: In that way, it’s also not easy to prepare.

dialogue.text: ¿Mba’éichapa oñemba’apo nde tembiapo rehe? Ahendu che rehé.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ajeporú nderesayvéva para tener un estilo más claro. Oñemba’apóva mbegueite, heñoiva ikatu haguã mitã rehe.

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.speaker: Cliente
dialogue.text: ¡Mba’éichapa umíva ñemohenda apy ñembohetave? Añamombete mbovy.
dialogue.translation: How can I contact you urgently? I need to explain an error.

dialogue.speaker: Atención al cliente
dialogue.text: Téra mba’éichapa nderéra? Jajuhúva niko pya’e.
dialogue.translation: Could you please tell me your name? We need to resolve this soon.

dialogue.speaker: Cliente
dialogue.text: Ñande téra Juan Pérez. Ñamombete te mbovy ojejapóva ñande tembiapokue.
dialogue.translation: My name is Juan Pérez. We really need to explain the mistake you made.

dialogue.speaker: Atención al cliente
dialogue.text: Jaikuaa, upéichaite. ¿Mba’éichapa ñamombete umíva tembiapokue?
dialogue.translation: I understand, that's right. How can we explain what happened?

dialogue.speaker: Cliente
dialogue.text: Ojehechakuaa ta’añohẽ umíva tembiapo pyahu. Pe tembiapokue oiko mbovy.
dialogue.translation: They reviewed our work yesterday. Your service was incorrect.

dialogue.speaker: Atención al cliente
dialogue.text: Arohory, péicha avei. Jajuhúva pya’e ñanohẽ umíva tembiapokue.
dialogue.translation: Okay, I understand that too. We will review what happened quickly.

dialogue.speaker: Cliente
dialogue.text: ¡Chepota! Ha’eva’ekue umíva oñemohenda apy ñembohetave.
dialogue.translation: Thank you! It's important that you contact me urgently.

key_phrases.translation: How can I contact you urgently?

dialogue.text: Aje ñeha’ã ko’ág̃a avei ambue mba’e ñemombyky haguã. Ndaha’éi mba’eve opaichagua kuatiápe.
dialogue.translation: Yo también tengo este plan para lograr otras cosas. No es nada que no esté en todos los periódicos.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Nde ñe’ẽ ha che ñe’ẽ oiko jyke. Opa mba’e osẽ mba’eve.
dialogue.translation: Your word and mine exist here. Everything that comes out is nothing.

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Nde kuatiápe oje’e mba’éichapa oñeha’ã opaichagua temimbo’ekuéra.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Jajapo haguã. Oïmi mba’éichapa oñeha’ãva’erã kuéra kuatiápe.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: — ¿Mba'eichagua mba'e rejoguáta ñande katu rehe? (¿Qué tipo de comida consumes para estar bien?)
dialogue.translation: —¿What kind of things do you eat to feel good?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: — Aho, sapy'ápe aju jave ñeho, ha ñande juky mba'eve. (Bueno, a veces como ligero cuando salgo, pero nada pesado.)
dialogue.translation: — Well, sometimes I eat light when I go out, but nothing heavy.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: — Ha ñe rejogua mba'e reho jave? (¿Y qué comes cuando sales?)
dialogue.translation: — And what do you eat when you go out?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: — Ho, ñe ho jave, aju juky mba'e, pe ichupe. (Bueno, cuando salgo, como algo ligero, eso es.)
dialogue.translation: — Well, when I go out, I eat something light, that's it.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: — ¡Jajogua ñande jave juky mba'eve! (¡Empecemos a comer algo ligero siempre!)
dialogue.translation: — Let's start eating something light all the time!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: — Katu, jave ñeñongatú ñande ha'e. (Bien, cuando nos cuidamos el uno al otro.)
dialogue.translation: — Good, when we take care of each other.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: — Upéicha, ñande ñembo'e peteĩ tembiapo heta. (Así, hacemos muchas cosas buenas.)
dialogue.translation: — That way, we do many good things.

dialogue.text: Che rembiapo ojecha porãicha he’i chupe: "Ndeve nderehecha peteĩa ne rendápe."

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: —¿ónde rejeko peteĩ ñembo’eha upéi? Peve okyhyje pukáta.
dialogue.translation: —¿Dónde haces una reunión después? Hasta aquí está sucio, abrélo.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: —Ha’e tapiá gui, upéi ñamombe’úta mba’e oñemba’apóva ndive.
dialogue.translation: —Está limpio de ahí, entonces lo hablaremos con lo que trabaja con nosotros.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: —Upéi ha’e mba’e oñe’ẽva jey rehe? Peve ohechaukáicha.
dialogue.translation: —Entonces, ¿qué se va a decir otra vez sobre eso? Hasta se ve así.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: —Nda ha’ei jei. Upéi ñemba’apóta mba’eve kuéra oñembyatyva ỹre.
dialogue.translation: —No es así. Entonces haremos algo para quienes trabajan juntos sin nada.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: —Peve oikóva pukáta gui oñemba’eporáva yvype kuéra.
dialogue.translation: —Hasta se encontrará abierto desde el lugar que cuida el río con ellos.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: —Jajapóta pukáta. Upéi upéva tapiáta.
dialogue.translation: —Lo haremos abrir. Entonces ese lugar quedará limpio.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: —Upéipe ndaha’éi pukáta gui oñe’ẽva ñande rire.
dialogue.translation: —Entonces no será abrir de donde se nos habla después.

key_phrases.translation: Then, what will be said again about that?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: ¿Mba'éichapa oñe'ẽ umi tupá Paraguái ha España? ¿Mombe'úta upéicha?
dialogue.translation: How do they talk about customs in Paraguay and Spain? Can you explain it like this?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Oñe'ẽ vere tembiapokuaa, icha upéicha oñeñongatu ha ojeporeka umi tupákuéra. Cheve oho ha'evoi oñepytyvõ haguã.
dialogue.translation: They talk about activities and knowledge, but also about how customs are accepted and sought. To me, that is very useful for helping each other.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Tupá Paraguáipe tapyta tembiapo apytépe, ha upeicha oñe'ẽ umi ñe'ẽkuéra oñepytyvõva.
dialogue.translation: Customs in Paraguay are closely tied to daily activities, and in this way, they talk about the words that help understand.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: ¡Ha'e porã! Mba'éichapa oñemombe'u umi tembiapo oñeñongatúva ha ojekuaa avei umi ñe'ẽ oĩva.
dialogue.translation: That's good! How do they explain those activities that are accepted and also the words that exist?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Oñe'ẽ jeporeka ha oñongatu umi tupákuéra, vere oñepytyvõ tembiapokuaa oimeva'erã.
dialogue.translation: They talk about investigating and accepting customs, only to help the knowledge that should exist.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Upéicha upéi, avei oñemombe'u umi tupá, ikatu ndaha'éi avei umi ñe'ẽ oñeñe'ẽ haguã ojejapóva.
dialogue.translation: That's how it is, and also, they recount customs, even if it's not the same as the words used to make someone speak.

dialogue.speaker: A
